page.overview:
What is Unidentified planet?

A planet in the galaxy that was many parsecs away from Markez Moon. The planet had a pipeline that transported Rhydonium during the Imperial Era. Wilmon Paak, Saw Gerrera and his Partisans used a a piece of equipment to steal an amount of Rhydonium from the pipeline.

The planet appeared, though it was not identified, in "I Have Friends Everywhere," the fifth episode of the second season of the television series Star Wars: Andor released on Disney+
